svg.title: Sexually transmitted infections sorted by how they present: discharge or cervicitis (chlamydia, gonorrhea), pelvic pain and fever (pelvic inflammatory disease), genital ulcer (herpes, syphilis), warts and bloodborne infections (HPV, hepatitis B, HIV); the test, test of cure, treatment, partner and admission rules for each

svg.text: STI: sort by HOW IT PRESENTS, and that picks the test

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: most are ASYMPTOMATIC: screening finds them, not symptoms

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: REPORTABLE: chlamydia · gonorrhea · syphilis ·HIV ·hepatitis B + C → trace + treat contacts

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: trichomonas + yeast: VAGINAL DISCHARGE chart · molluscum: VULVAR LESIONS chart

svg.text: swab cervix or vagina, or FIRST-CATCH URINE ≥ 2 h after voiding

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: treat for BOTH: co-infection is likely

svg.text: • chlamydia + gonorrhea: cervical or vaginal swab, or first-catch urine

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • herpes: unroof → PCR · syphilis: darkfield, VDRL screen, FTA confirm

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • hepatitis B, HIV: serology · warts: clinical

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • PID: cultures + imaging, laparoscopy if unsure

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • test of cure (chlamydia): only if pregnant, poor compliance, symptoms persist or re-exposed · at 4 weeks

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • reportable → public health traces contacts; treat partners before sex resumes
